sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar.
Our order history for this part shows 5.17 EUR (po:4500013023-10) against 5.45 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014455-10).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered until March 2027.
Our volume forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Today you supply 80 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 24-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are always keen to support your requirements with our extensive range and reliable service!

For our updated offer, we can propose a price of €5.21 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We welcome your proposal for a 36-month commitment and have adopted the 60-day payment terms from your first package. As we cannot offer fixed prices over this duration, we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause. We have verified the delivery record you cited; while noted, it does not impact our pricing structure.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We appreciate your proposal for long-term planning certainty.
Please note that a 5% deadband leaves us exposed to initial material price fluctuations, thereby increasing our risk rather than removing it.
By maintaining the AS-14404 index clause without a deadband, we can offer a reduced base price of €5.17 per unit for a 24-month term.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
